# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 84 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 84 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_084_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9 — The Great Tower Vision Begins

**1** After I had finished writing down all the commandments and parables of the Shepherd — the angel of repentance — he came to me again and said, "I want to show you everything that the Holy Spirit revealed to you in the image of the Church. That Spirit is the Son of God himself. **2** Because you were not yet strong enough in the faith to receive a direct angelic vision without fear, it was revealed to you through the form of the Church — so you could see it clearly and not be terrified." **3** In the Spirit he showed me a vast white rock rising up from a flat plain. It was higher than any mountain, perfectly square, large enough to hold the entire world. **4** The rock was ancient and venerable, with a gate carved into it — but the gate looked freshly made. It blazed more brilliantly than the sun, and its radiance left me speechless. **5** Twelve virgins stood around the gate. The four stationed at the corners appeared to me the most powerful, though all twelve were radiant with glory. They stood at each corner of the gate. **6** The remaining ten virgins were positioned between them, arranged along the sides in an orderly row. **7** About twenty young men stood before the gate — strong, vigorous, full of energy. **8** The gate stood open. Inside I could see large square white stones being fitted into place on both sides of the gate, forming the foundation of a tower. **9** The tower rising above the gate was breathtaking — magnificent beyond description — and it appeared to be made from a single seamless stone. That stone was so clear and bright it surpassed even the whiteness of fresh snow.

---

*PNEUMA renders the vision's sublime quality with heightened descriptive language, emphasizing the overwhelming beauty that signals divine presence.*
